questions.question: According to the fundamental rights provided by the Constitution of India, the state is bound to provide free and compulsory education to all children from the age of:
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**6 to 14 years.**__

__
 
• The Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education Act or Right to Education Act (RTE), describes the modalities of the importance of free and compulsory education for children between 6 and 14 in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Constitution (Eighty-sixth Amendment) Act, 2002 inserted Article 21-A in the Constitution of India to provide free and compulsory education of all children in the age group of six to fourteen years as a Fundamental Right. 
 
• **Article 21-A** and the RTE Act came into effect on 1 April 2010. The title of the RTE Act incorporates the words ‘free and compulsory.
 
• ‘Free education means that no child, other than a child who has been admitted by his or her parents to a school which is not supported by the appropriate Government, shall be liable to pay any kind of fee or charges or expenses which may prevent him or her from pursuing and completing elementary education.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT an example of an optical disk?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**PROM.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **PROM** stands for Programmable Read-Only Memory.

 
 
• Read-only memory (ROM) is a type of memory that is used in electronics and computers.
 
• It is a non-volatile memory, that is, information stored in such memory is permanent and cannot be changed.
 
 
 
• DVD:
 
 
• It stands for Digital Versatile Disc or Digital Video Disc.
 
• It is a digital optical disc storage format invented and developed in 1995 and released in late 1996.
 
• The medium can store any kind of digital data and is widely used for software and other computer files.
 
• It offers 4.7 GB (single-sided, single-layer – common), 8.5 GB (single-sided, double-layer), 9.4 GB (double-sided, single-layer), 17.08 GB (double-sided, double-layer) storage capacity.
 
 
 
• Blu-ray Disc (BD):
 
 
• It is a digital optical disc data storage format.
 
• It can store several hours of video in high-definition (HDTV 720p and 1080p).
 
• The main application of Blu-ray is as a medium for video material such as feature films and for the physical distribution of video games for the PlayStation 3, Xbox One etc.
 
 
 
• CD: 
 
 
• It stands for Compact Disc.
 
• It is a digital optical disc data storage format that was co-developed by Philips and Sony and released in 1982.
 
• It offers a storage capacity of 700 MB.
 
 

**Hence PROM is not an example of Optical Disk. **

questions.question: Swollen bluish veins resulting from the valves that do not close properly are called ______.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**varicose veins.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Varicose veins are abnormally dilated, tortuous superficial veins caused by incompetent venous valves.
 
• They almost always affect the legs and feet.
 
• Veins have cup-like valves alternately open to allow blood flow towards the heart then close to prevent backflow.
 
• In varicose veins, the valves do not work properly allowing blood to pool in the vein, increasing venous pressure and like the hood of congestion, vein bulge, and twist.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Prevention from varicose veins:

 
 
• Lose weight
 
• Daily exercise
 
• Avoid standing for extended periods of time
 
• Should avoid injury
 
• Use compression socks

questions.question: Who among the following was responsible for the partition of Bengal in 1905?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is__** ​Lord Curzon.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Partition of Bengal was announced on 19 July 1905 by Lord Curzon, the then Viceroy of India, and implemented on 16 October 1905.
 
• Lord Curzon was the then Viceroy of India and he announced the partition of Bengal.
 
• The stated reason was to ease the administration but the actual reason was to weaken the growing nationalism in Bengal.
 
• As per Curzon, after the partition, the two provinces would be Bengal (including modern West Bengal, Odisha, and Bihar) and Eastern Bengal and Assam.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Annulment of Bengal__

 
 
• The partition of Bengal was annulled in 1911.
 
• Partition of Bengal was cancelled by Lord Hardinge II.
 
• The capital of British India was moved to Delhi from Calcutta in 1911.
 
• Despite the annulment, the partition already succeeded in making a communal divide between Muslims and Hindus of Bengal.

questions.question: Which of the following gases is released in the process of photosynthesis?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Oxygen**__.

__
 
• In the presence of sunlight Carbon dioxide + water + sunlight → Carbohydrate + oxygen.
 
• So Carbon dioxide is absorbed while Oxygen gas is released in the process. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Photosynthesis: 
 
• The leaves have a green pigment called chlorophyll.
 
 
• It helps leaves to capture the energy of the sunlight.
 
• This energy is used to synthesise food from carbon dioxide and water. 
 
• Since the synthesis of food occurs in the presence of sunlight, it is called photosynthesis.
 
 
 
• Some plants, green algae, and cyanobacteria can perform photosynthesis.
 
• Photosynthesis occurs in the chloroplasts specifically, in the grana and stroma regions.
 
• The process of photosynthesis is commonly written as:

​

 underset{(Carbon dioxide)}{6CO₂} + underset{(Water)}{6H₂ O} xrightarrow[Chlorophyll]{Sunlight} underset{(Carbohydrates)}{C₆H₁₂O₆} + underset{(Oxygen)}{6O₂}

 
• The following events occur in plant cells during photosynthesis. 

 
 
• Absorption of light energy.
 
• Conversion of light energy into Chemical Energy.
 
• Storage of chemical energy in Sugars.

questions.question: Which of the following statements is **NOT **correct about alluvial soil?

options.text: Old alluvial is called ‘bangar’ and new alluvial is called ‘khadar’.
Deltas of Mahanadi, the Godavari and the Krishna are made from alluvial soil
Northern plains are made of alluvial soil
In the Himalayan region we find alluvial soil.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__In the Himalayan region we find alluvial soil.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Alluvial soil is not found In the Himalayan region.**
 
• **Alluvial soils:**
 
 
• These soils are called** transported soil** because although they are formed near the water bodies, these soils get transported from their origin to several other places by various natural agents, especially by gravity.
 
• The alluvial soil is made up of particles like **silt, sand, and clay and has an adequate amount of phosphoric acid, potash, and lime.**
 
• It is of two types:
 
 
• The older alluvial soil is known as **Bhangar.**
 
• The newer alluvial soil is known as** Khadar.**
 
 
 
• The alluvial soil covers a total of** 40%** of the land.
 
• These soils are found in the **northern plains beginning from Punjab to West Bengal and Assam.**
 
• It is also** found in deltas of rivers like Krishna, Godavari, Kaveri, and Mahanadi in peninsular India.**
 
• The** main crops **cultivated are wheat, rice, maize, sugarcane, pulses, and oilseeds.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• On the basis of **genesis, color, composition, and location,** the soils of India have been classified into:

 
 
• (1) Alluvial soils (ii) Black soils (iii) Red and Yellow soils (iv) Laterite soils (V) Arid soils (vi) Saline soils (vii) Peaty soils (viii) Forest soils.
 
 
 
• On the** basis of the size of the particles **that make up a soil defines its gardening characteristics:
 
 
• (1) Clay soil (ii) Silty soil (iii) Sandy soil (iv) Stones (v) Chalky soils
 
 
 
• **Saline soil:**
 
 
• It refers to Arid soil.
 
• These are derived from the disintegration of adjacent rocks and are largely blown from coastal regions and the Indus valley.
 
• They are developed in western Rajasthan. Due to the dry climate, high temperature and accelerated evaporation, they lack moisture and humus.
 
 
 
• **Calcerous soil:**
 
 
• They are also known as chalky soils.
 
• These soils contain calcium carbonate or lime.
 
• They are very alkaline and may be light or heavy.

questions.question: A device or program that enables a computer to transmit data over telephone or cable lines is called:
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__Modem.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **​****A modem** is a device or program that enables a computer to transmit data over, for example, telephone or cable lines.
 
• Computer information is stored digitally, whereas information transmitted over telephone lines is transmitted in the form of analog waves.
 
• A modem is a hardware device that allows a computer to send and receive data over a telephone line or a cable or satellite connection.
 
• MODEM stands for **modulator-demodulator**.
 
• A modem is used for** transmitting and receiving data over a communication channel,** such as twisted-pair telephone lines, coaxial cables, and optical fibers.
 
• At the source, the modulation technique is used to convert the analog signal to digital.
 
• At the receiver, demodulation is used to convert the digital signal back to analog.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **​A motherboard:**

 
 
• It is also called mainboard, main circuit board, system board, baseboard, planar board, logic board, or mobo and is the main printed circuit board (PCB) in general-purpose computers.
 
 
 
• **The monitor:**
 
 
• It is the output device that helps to display soft copy.
 
 
 
• **A computer mouse:**
 
 
• It is an input device used to control/operate a computer.
 
• Douglas Engelbart invented the computer Mouse.
 
• A mouse tracks the 2-D movement on the surface it is kept/used and correspondingly moves the pointer on the monitor.
 
• Engelbart has also founded a separate field, human-computer interaction (HCI).
 
• A human using the mouse to interact with a computer would come under the ambit of HCI.
 
 

 

b7:T
